sources.entry: Chamilo LMS - Create a virtual campus for the provision of online or semi-online training. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Chamilo is a GPLv3 PHP-based e-learning platform (LMS) for creating online and semi-online courses, sessions, and training campuses.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Chamilo 3 as an e-learning platform used for course creation and delivery, with a broad feature list. Listed features include courses, documents, forums, assignments, quizzes (20+ question types), learning paths, gradebook with badges and certificates, surveys, skills management, and attendance tracking. It supports standards such as SCORM 1.2, QTI, LTI, xAPI CMI 5, and Aiken (partial SCORM 2004), plus a hierarchical multi-tenant "Multi-URLs" mode. Other listed items include a course catalogue with e-commerce, live chat, videoconference integrations, a JWT-authenticated API, 2FA/MFA, LDAP support via PHP's LDAP extension, and optional AI features. Installation is via a web installer on Apache/Nginx-style virtual hosts with PHP 8.3–8.5 and MariaDB or MySQL.
use_cases: host a virtual campus for students
offer SCORM or xAPI course content
how_to_run: sudo apt update && sudo apt -y upgrade
sudo apt install -y apache2 libapache2-mod-php mariadb-client mariadb-server php-{apcu,bcmath,cli,curl,dev,gd,intl,ldap,mbstring,mysql,redis,soap,xml,zip} unzip curl
Create a MariaDB database and user, then download and extract the Chamilo release into /var/www/chamilo
Copy public/main/install/apache.dist.conf to an Apache site config, set your domain, then enable the site and modules rewrite, ssl, headers, expires
sudo touch .env && sudo chown -R www-data: .env config/ var/ && restart Apache
Open the domain in a browser and complete the web installer; afterwards run chown -R root: .env config/
notable: Covers SCORM 1.2, QTI, LTI, xAPI CMI 5 and Aiken import/export standards
Hierarchical multi-tenant mode (Multi-URLs) for multiple sites from one install
Attendance tracking with Qualiopi reporting and gradebook badges with QR-code certificates
Optional AI features (OpenAI, Grok, Gemini, Claude, DeepSeek) and an MCP connector
caveats: AI and some integrations may require active subscriptions to external services
Partial SCORM 2004 support only; roles and permissions management is marked beta
Requires a dedicated domain or subdomain (not a subfolder) and a self-managed SSL setup; the README leaves SSL to the user
